# ankra_teams_channels (Data Source)

Lists the channels of every Microsoft Teams team the Ankra bot is installed in, across the organisation's connected tenants, for the `channel_id`, `channel_name` and `teams_tenant_id` of a Teams `ankra_alert_destination`. Fails when no Teams tenant is connected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_teams_channels" "tenants" {}

locals {
  teams_oncall_channel = one([for channel in data.ankra_teams_channels.tenants.channels : channel if channel.team_name == "Platform" && channel.name == "On-call"])
}

resource "ankra_alert_destination" "teams_oncall" {
  name             = "teams-oncall"
  integration_type = "teams"
  channel_id       = local.teams_oncall_channel.id
  channel_name     = local.teams_oncall_channel.name
  teams_tenant_id  = local.teams_oncall_channel.tenant_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `channels` (Attributes List) Channels the bot can post to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--channels))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.

<a id="nestedatt--channels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `channels`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Teams channel id, the destination's `channel_id`.
- `name` (String) Channel name.
- `team_id` (String) Team the channel belongs to.
- `team_name` (String) Team name.
- `tenant_id` (String) Microsoft tenant, the destination's `teams_tenant_id`.
